a.text: Blood rain falls incessantly, as if it will never stop.
Logos and Amiya's shoulders have been soaked red by the rain.
The white-haired Vampire, however, seems to stroll casually under the rain, completely spotless.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Look at the sorry state of yourselves.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Lost in confusion, losing sight of what matters.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Even if no one answers your cries, you can't waste the stage you've been given, don't waste your chance at a grand farewell.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: 'I state it, therefore, it is prescribed.'

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: 'The wind and rain cease, deprived of the right to flow.'

a.text: The moment the words are spoken, the blood rain freezes in midair.
Like curtains, like stars, it refracts the sorrow of the sea, the brilliance of the moons.
The Sanguinarch squints, seemingly unsurprised by the incantation of the Lord of the Banshees. Rather, it is as if he is appreciating a piece of art drawn between heaven and earth.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You've halted the surging? Impressive. Blood pauses at your command.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: But—I am its master.

a.text: The suspended beads of blood suddenly burst in the air, splattering anything they can reach.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: The knell will decay, the order will wear, no?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: If you so disdain your noble blood, I might as well extract it and return it to your mother, Banshee.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: She will play for you a mournful whistle.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Amiya!

a.text: The Vampire only gives Amiya a momentary opportunity, but it is more than enough.
Amiya's palm presses against the Vampire's body, sticky blood burning her palm.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is this your blood?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Heated by Arts, heated by your talent.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But the hot blood I've seen—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: —has all been for the sake of resistance, for the sake of life.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And those people, their blood is much hotter than yours.

a.text: Black lines burst from Amiya's palm, piercing through the Vampire's body.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Hngh.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Amiya, fall back!

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: You didn't get his vitals!

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Oh how cold, King of Sarkaz.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: A monarch of such little grace you are.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Sanguinarch of Vampires, Prince of the Crimson Court, your offspring fill every battlefield the Sarkaz touch.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You proclaim to them that slaughter and conquest are the ancient traditions of the Vampires.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You've shaped your court into what it is today. You've made the people see all Vampires as nothing more than twisted creatures of desire like yourself.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But the Vampires I know are not like you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They haven't gone mad like you.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: They've only managed to conceal their desires, conditioned to deeply by this age in which they have no home.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Some choose to bow down to the invaders, and I pity them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, that's not it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: How do you interpret the blood that your court stands for?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: The sufferings of the Sarkaz need no elucidation. All Sarkaz, even those who submit to you, inevitably know the taste of blood.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Overturned in dark alleys, intercepted in dark forests, sometimes a throat is cut, sometimes cold daggers are thrust between ribs.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: It awakens the siblings, who now know the cost of submission, and they come to rebel until they too are covered in the blood of their enemies.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: How pitiful.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Kill or be killed, this is the cycle of blood that the Sarkaz carry.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is that how you define the meaning of blood? A cycle?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The first time any of us felt blood on our skin, wasn't it... when we were born from our mothers?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Blood is the foundation of human life, heritage passed down on umbilical cords, inevitable stumbles when exploring the outside world, and wounds that will surely heal.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But you see it only as a synonym for torment and death.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Your obsession makes you bloodthirsty.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You, with all your arrogance and pride, lead them to believe that this is the path the Sarkaz should take, the things they should do.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I reject you, Sanguinarch.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I reject your actions, your words, and your court.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Ahahahahah! What is this I'm hearing?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You, an outblood, reject me?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: A mere crown has inflated you to what... King of Sarkaz?

spans.text: A mere crown has inflated you to what...

a.text: The blood sea churns, its waves cover the moons.
Crimson removes all other colors.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't care what I am, or what I'm called.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I only know what I need to do.

a.text: The Prince stops moving for a moment.
A voice echoes in his mind.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Is this how you manipulate the King's power, Cautus?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Will you share some profound words? Try to shake me with shallow emotion?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You're welcome to try.

a.text: Shake? No.
This is a rejection.
The rolling of the waves slows, together with the moonlight.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I reject you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I reject you, the way you reduce the King, the Sarkaz, and Kazdel to concepts of power and tradition.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I reject you, how you entrust the future to the past, entrust life to slaughter.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Theresa, the King, the Chancellor, the leader of Babel, she showed everyone a path.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Maybe that path is too idealistic, maybe her promises won't bear the thousands of years of hatred of the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But that's not now, not your choice.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You'd laugh at my weakness? Say it's not my place to talk about the Sarkaz with you?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Or you'd mock Logos for not making use of the blood you 'awakened' just now?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Oh, King of Sarkaz... You eavesdrop on my thoughts? Is that your ability?

spans.text: ... You eavesdrop on my thoughts? Is that your ability?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Then of course you know what I'm going to say.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I do.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But we've never said that the Sarkaz should give up their resistance. We've never said that suffering is justified.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: On the contrary—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Those rebels who awaken from their suffering and hardship, from the abyss of hatred—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They will be much, much stronger than you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The lost homeland of the Sarkaz is not in the history you keep looking back to, an eon ago.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It can't be a slogan, or fantasy, or symbol.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's right here, where the Sarkaz came from.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: In the city called Kazdel, where so many real people live, people that you've only condemned to a void of ideas.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You've imagined the present from the past, and the real future can never be born.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's time to stop, Vampire.

a.text: Amiya's ring shatters, sending splinters flying.
Cold anger burns within Amiya as she scrutinizes the enemy before her.
She thought her anger would rise, burning like a fire that could scorch the ocean.
But no, that's not what's happening.
Amiya feels more than just anger, also an intense... sadness.
The Sarkaz, a people who have lost their homeland.
Yes, they believe that it is only through violence and war that they can reclaim all they've lost.
It's easy to blame them, with cliche words of morality, justice, and kindness.
Words that have been spoken over and over again, even as the war continues, and hatred spreads.
Because that is how this world treats them.
This world has imposed on them violence and war.
So then, what's wrong with an eye for an eye? Where is the crime in blood for blood?
Every King of Sarkaz operates on those principles, so the war never stops.
This must be broken, but how... how can this system be broken?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Even Theresa failed. What do you think you are?

a.text: Yes, even she failed.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's why Theresa needs me. The Doctor and Dr. Kal'tsit need me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And that's why I'm here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I, as the revenant called me, as you called me, as so many Sarkaz believe me to be—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The outblood—the weak—King of Sarkaz.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Stand down.

a.text: The obsidian decree transforms into the judgment of the King, stabbing into the scorched blood.
The thick red finally dissipates—
The Vampire takes a few steps back, raising his hand to wipe away the blood that flows from his nose and mouth.
His body is damaged, and his white clothes are at last stained with blood.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You can't fight anymore, Sanguinarch.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's time for this battle to end.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: King of Sarkaz, won't you grant me that vision of emptiness?

spans.text: won't you grant me that vision of emptiness?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Don't you want to peer into my thoughts, see my sorrows and pain?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You can reprimand me, reject me. Countless Sarkaz believe this is the power of the King.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You say I've corrupted my court, but what about you?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Oh King, the Sarkaz take your direction, your path. My people follow you, expecting you to well exploit their flesh and blood, their lives, and their souls.

spans.text: the Sarkaz take your direction, your path. My people follow you, expecting you to well exploit their flesh and blood, their lives, and their souls.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Their blind faith is ridiculous.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I sneer at the King's comfort, but... I have seen it.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: My elder brother was a King of Sarkaz.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Hah, what a lofty title, what a transcendent role—

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: He was looked to as the leader of the Sarkaz, our guiding light.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: He was a natural savior, the one who would pull us out of our misery.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: But what was the reality?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: What kind of people has the Black Crown chosen?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: In the beginning, the King of Sarkaz was indeed magnificent, the Diαblos walked the path of punishment, the Goliaths roared the fearless calamity—

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: But they found themselves betrayed by the cowardly, sold out by the selfish.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: This is our curse.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: 'The King killed the King.'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Succession to this crown often comes with death.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: The vile always prevail.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: As such, the Crown was besmirched by shortsighted fools.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: The weak began to appear among the Kings.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: They were narrow-minded, focused on toying with the power the held in their hands—They became no better than the hypocritical lords among the Elders and Ancients.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: The power they stole from others clouded their vision. The focus of my people's faith turned from fearless warriors to vermin hiding in their palaces.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: They even forgot the shame borne by the name 'Sarkaz'!

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: But the Crown continued to make its laughable choices, right up to my brother.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I thought surely he would be the hero we had waited for!

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: He, on the other hand, had the audacity to say to me that the Sarkaz could no longer afford to continue to war, that it would take generations to rebuild Kazdel...

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Even the skeleton beneath our feet knows that the Kazdel we should rebuild was never meant to be a city. And that the 'King of Sarkaz' should be the one to stand before them all.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: How can a man like that deserve to hold a single drop of Teekaz blood within his body?!

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Do you see it, King of Sarkaz?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I see... a bloody civil war.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The carpets of the palace are soaked red.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I see a... Vampire, lying in the arms of another Vampire.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: The legend of 'The Toppled Blood Prince'.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: He died in a civil war. You're his kin, did you fight in the war?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: No! Of course not! 'Did I fight?'

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I shattered the Crown myself!

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I remember it like it was yesterday. My hand pierced his chest. The limpid Teekaz blood danced on my fingertip, finally entering my veins.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: He turned his head to look at me, grabbing my clothes... The 'King of Sarkaz' showed his illusory vision to his murderer before he died, the vision that should have been bestowed as an honor.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: In the vision, I saw... I witnessed, peace.

spans.text: In the vision, I saw... I witnessed,

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: As you said, Cautus, blood is not synonymous with death. I stood in the valley, watching a quiet village, a doctor laughing as he spoke, stitching up wounds for the injured.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: An injured man tells the doctor that his quarry was particularly ferocious, but he eventually won out. In the courtyard hangs the freshly harvested beastmeat.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: ...And the doctor is me.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: But this makes me uncontrollably angry.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: How tragic, how meaningless, how shameful! My brother actually believed that this false 'peace' could deceive me? He was horrifically wrong!

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: He thought I was blinded by hatred? No, I know what peace is. And that's exactly why I feel so restless!

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: We long to see the great and powerful, true Teekaz!

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I absorbed my brother's blood into my body, and I watched as the Black Crown vanished before my eyes—

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: But you did not ascend to the throne of the 'King of Sarkaz'.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: And I do not regret that. If it could choose a formidable leader, I would be genuinely delighted.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: But this Crown disappoints me time and time again. Each time I am more disappointed.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: My brother's successor was a wandering vagrant. The next was a lumberjack. If it weren't for the records kept by the Confessarii, these people would not be remembered at all.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Later, a King who ruled Kazdel was killed by the monster called Kal'tsit in the sight of the coalition army.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Then came Theresa and Theresis.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: They were impressive, but also frustrating. Theresa, immersed in her fantasies, wasted her strength, much like my... weak elder brother.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: And her successor... turned out to be a Cautus, an outblood.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Things being what they are, the Crown's choices being so absurd, even as its existence brings such humiliating hope to my people—

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I would rather bury it beyond the reach of civilization. I will let it be truly lost, forgotten to history.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: You're still struggling.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Amiya, don't give him a chance.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You are weakening too. However tarnished the Crown may be, its weight is not something an infantile Cautus could bear.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: It seems the Confessarii so eager to manipulate the Crown are going to blather some nonsense at me.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Take another look around, Cautus. If you die, there will be no more 'successors'.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Or maybe you'd place your crown on the moons?

a.text: The flowing blood surges toward the Sanguinarch's body.
The white-haired Sarkaz stands proudly once again.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What...? How can he still fight?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The King's Arts should have pierced his body, leaving it unable to regenerate!

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: He is using blood to fill the holes in his flesh, using it to mend his wounds.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: He's a marionette now.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You've become more proficient in the use of the King's power, Cautus.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: But all your admonitions, warnings, judgments, and proclamations are nothing but jokes.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Ignorant little rabbit, the crown over your head represents no responsibility or authority.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: King of Sarkaz, hah. I mock not only your foolishness, but that of the King.

spans.text: hah. I mock not only your foolishness, but that of the King.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: And that of the Crown itself.

a.text: The once vibrant red that filled the entire space no longer exists.
Only a bit of crimson oozes from the Sanguinarch's pupils.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: When the Sarkaz lose the King on which they're so dependent, then perhaps they will wake up from this shameful dream of a coming salvation.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I accede to your statement, that those awakening from a dream will be much more powerful.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: And that is why you cannot defeat me.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: How can the fallen consciousness of the Sarkaz resist me, who once carried the blood of the Teekaz?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: The polluted cannot defile the pure, the impure cannot touch the limpid.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Your origin lies in the Teekaz, a long line you can only climb!

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: We are the rebels!

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: 'I decree, therefore, I correct.'

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: 'Blood and fire extinguished, face to doom.'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Look out, Logos!

a.text: A touch of crimson appears from nothing.
The space once occupied by the Banshee is replaced by blood.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: *cough*!

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: His blood, it's... affecting me.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Several times stronger than those Arts Circles—

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Yes, thanks to you, I have also shed my blood here.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: And therefore—

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: This place is now part of Kazdel.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Who would have thought that as much as anyone assumed they knew the full length and breadth of this great land...

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: The boundaries of our home are still expanding, even in this time and place.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Sarkaz, my self-proclaimed Sarkaz kin!

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: March with your blood, carry on with that which will never betray you, the boon of your blood!

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I will take you back to the origin of all of this.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: And that is—

a.text: A shadow pierces his chest.
Threads of blood holding him together are severed in an instant.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Sorry, Sarkaz boons don't do much for me.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Bunny!

steps.name: W
steps.text: You *Sarkaz profanity* aren't Sarkaz! Hop to it! Weaken his binds!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's what I'm doing! His Arts are even... crazier than I imagined!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can barely hear his thoughts anymore, there's... there's only red... all red...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I've almost... got it!

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Another outblood... an unexpected development.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: The scent of your blood... you're Caprinae?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Such a dull disguise... let's have your blood suffocate you.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Urk!

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Do you think such crude Arts would let you kill a King of the Sarkaz Royal Court?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Of course not.

a.text: A heavy sword points directly at the Sanguinarch's head.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You can't call something as cliche as slaughter an 'awakening', Sanguinarch.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You're still wandering in hatred and destruction, you've never left the 'abyss'.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You're the ones who are still sleeping.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: —Vile traitors—

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: King of Sarkaz!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Now!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Before he recovers, knock him off the skeleton!

a.text: An elegy begins to play.
The wailing of the Banshee weaves into a mournful melody, and the waves beneath his feet sing a solemn song.
A steady male voice harmonizes with the sound of the bells, with moonlight as his prose.
The bone whistle sounds itself before it is played.
Its distant howl, traversing time itself, strikes the Crimson Court.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: The moment I took my throne, the knells were already tied to my fate.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: None of us can escape.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: But what the elegy mourns will not be your corpse.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: It will be all of our connections.

a.text: The Sanguinarch continues to struggle, blood gushing from his fingertips, like claws carving deep scratches into the bleached skull of the Feranmut.
His body disintegrates into the dirge, only to reform in blood.
He is the icon of blood, and as long as there is blood, he will continue to fight.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I—will not—Banshee—

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Amiya, join me.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Explore the strings of the elegy. Seek out the origin of the Banshee.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Look at me. Look to the wails you once covered your ears to avoid.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: We must end him here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll try!

a.text: The Banshee's song echoes again, and the ancient knells seem to materialize, deterring the creeping blood.
The Vampire still rises.
After a moment, a rather tender feminine voice joins the harmonic dirge.
A proclamation of death? A sentence of rejection?
No, not only. The melody carries a kind of timidity, and lingering... sadness.
As the blood cools, the moonlight changes. The hatred of the Sarkaz is not unreasonable, and the Vampire's vengeance is not unreasonable.
However, this is by no means the promised future. Can the survivors have a future, on scorched earth?
No!
What do those siblings... actually see?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Banshee! Listen!

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You have still—Accepted your blood, my boon—

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You have not yet... defeated yourself!

a.text: What echoes here is no longer an elegy.
It is only a sigh.
A sigh that makes him uneasy.
The heat of the explosion and the weight of the sword make the Sanguinarch feel powerless for the first time.
He looks at the small, ever so small, King of Sarkaz.
He looks at that Cautus, so inferior to the Sarkaz. He looks at the Black Crown, such a meaningless curse.
The history and illusions he trampled on, the bloodline and inheritance, the revenge and unrivaled power, all suddenly disappear.
He feels a void beneath his feet.
A figure in white falls from the skeleton.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Ridiculous... even the myriad souls mock me.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Lord of the Banshees, and... King of Sarkaz.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You keep these deserters around who ignore the past, and in the end, you don't even dare to act yourselves.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Oh... the vile always prevail.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: This is indeed our curse.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: The outblood King has executed me?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: The King of Sarkaz resounds with the knells. But you don't know how strong the ties of blood are. You try to judge...

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Heh, in the end, you did use the power within your blood!

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Two elegiac singers offered me a dirge at the same time—

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: When the time came, you could not resist the instinct within your blood that comprises all that you are.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Did you really kill me? No.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I have returned the Teekaz blood to where it belongs...

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Go and see, go to Londinium—

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: (Whispered Sarkaz) I'll be waiting for you behind the curtain of ruin.
